Operating System: Windows 11, 64-bit
 Processor: 13th Gen Intel N100 Processor (4 cores, up to 3.4GHz turbo speed, 6MB cache, 4 threads)
 Memory: Up to 32GB DDR5-4800 SO-DIMM RAM
 Storage: Up to 640GB Total Storage (128GB UFS Internal + 512GB External Flash Drive)
 Graphics: Integrated Intel UHD Graphics
 Optical Drive: None
 Form Factor: All-in-One
 Display: 21.5" Full HD (1920x1080) IPS Display, Anti-glare, 16:9 aspect ratio, 60Hz refresh rate, low blue light, flicker-free
 Audio: High-Definition stereo speakers with enhanced clarity
 Camera: HD webcam with privacy shutter and built-in dual microphone for clear video calls
 Keyboard & Mouse: Traditional Wired USB Keyboard & Mouse
 Ports & Connectivity:
 1x USB Type-C (5Gbps, data transfer only)
 2x USB Type-A (Hi-Speed)
 1x USB Type-A (5Gbps)
 1x 3.5mm headphone/microphone combo jack
 1x RJ-45 Ethernet port
 1x HDMI-out
 WiFi 6 & Bluetooth 5.3 for high-speed wireless connectivity
 Power Supply: 65-Watt AC adapter
 Dimensions (H x W x D): Approx. 15.8 x 19.3 x 6.5 inches
 Weight: Around 10.5 lbs

items: 【Processor】 Latest 13th Gen Intel N100 Processor (4 cores, up to 3.4GHz, 6MB cache, 4 threads) with integrated Intel UHD Graphics, delivering efficient performance for everyday computing.
【Premium RAM and Storage】 Equipped with 8GB DDR5 RAM for smooth multitasking and responsiveness. 128GB SSD storage ensures fast boot-up speeds and quick access to essential files and applications.

【Ports】 1x USB Type-C (5Gbps, data transfer only), 2x USB Type-A (Hi-Speed), 1x USB Type-A (5Gbps), 1x headphone/microphone combo (3.5mm), 1x RJ-45 Ethernet, 1x HDMI-out, and built-in WiFi 6 & Bluetooth 5.3 for seamless connectivity.

【Display and Built-in Features】 21.5" Full HD (1920 x 1080) display, offering sharp visuals with an anti-glare coating for comfortable viewing. Dual stereo speakers provide clear and immersive audio, while a built-in HD webcam with a privacy shutter ensures secure video conferencing and online meetings.

【Operating System】 Pre-installed with Windows 11 Pro (64-bit), providing enhanced security, business-grade features, and remote desktop support, making it an excellent choice for professionals and power users.
